== Summary ==
[[Aron Eisenberg]] (left) with columnist Jim Brumbaugh at Gen Con 2000 in Milwaukee. The printed caption reads: "Aron 'Nog' Eisenberg and the columnist"; the article's byline names the columnist as Jim Brumbaugh. Photo: Star Trek Communicator.

== Source ==
* Jim Brumbaugh, "Gen Con, Gaming & Gifts", ''Star Trek Communicator'' 131 (2000), Decipher, pp. 68–69; photograph on p. 69. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/star-trek-communicator-issue-131/page/n70/mode/1up Internet Archive] (leaf n70). The Internet Archive item is itself the preserved copy.
* Cropped from the page scan to the photograph only (box 1770,650 to 2468,1595 of the 2543×3268 leaf).

== Licensing ==
Non-free. Fair-use rationale: one reduced photograph from a magazine page reporting Gen Con 2000, used only to illustrate Aron Eisenberg's article on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the magazine or harm its market.
